info.title: Toiage Core — Educational Intelligence Platform
info.description: API for generating curriculum-aligned science projects, assessments, and educational content for CBSE classes 6-8.

post.description: Create a new child profile for the authenticated parent. The profile is stored in the database and used by the story/activity generation pipeline to personalize content.

get.summary: Get all children for the current parent
get.description: Retrieve all child profiles belonging to a parent, ordered by creation date (newest first). Provide the parent's user ID via the `parentId` query parameter.

schema.title: Response List Children Endpoint Children Get

get.description: Retrieve a single child profile by its unique identifier.

put.description: Update an existing child profile. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated (partial update).

delete.description: Delete a child profile by its unique identifier.

post.description: Send a raw prompt string directly to any configured LLM provider (mock, openrouter, deepseek). Use this for testing provider responses without templates.

post.summary: Load prompt template and send to LLM
post.description: Load a prompt template from the prompts/ directory, inject variables, prepend the system prompt (tone/safety rules), and send to an LLM provider. Use this to test prompt templates before integrating into business endpoints.

Generate a personalized, age-appropriate story based on parent-selected parameters (goal, mood, length, theme, today's context) and optionally a child profile for personalization. The story is generated via the LLM and persisted to the database in a single call. Provider defaults to 'mock' (no API key required); set provider='openrouter' to use the real model.

get.description: Retrieve all stories ordered by creation date (newest first).

post.description: Save a new story to the database. The story content should be generated beforehand, or use POST /stories/generate to do both in one call.

get.description: Retrieve a single story by its unique identifier.

post.description: Generate a hands-on, educational activity based on a story. Provide either an existing story_id or raw story_text. The activity includes a title, materials list, step-by-step instructions, and an open-ended challenge question. Supports 'household' mode (common items) and 'toy-kit' mode (toys/crafts).

400.description: Invalid request (missing story_id and story_text, or story not found)

get.description: Retrieve a single generated activity by its unique identifier.
Retrieve all generated activities ordered by creation date (newest first).

post.description: Upload a child's drawing, artwork, or creative image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF. Max file size: 10MB (configurable via MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB). Returns metadata including the URL for later reflection.

400.description: Invalid file type or file too large

post.description: Generate a warm, encouraging AI reflection on a child's uploaded artwork or creation. The AI describes what it sees positively and asks an open-ended curiosity question. Always age-appropriate, safe, and encouraging.

Generate a complete, curriculum-aligned science project for CBSE classes 6-8. Returns a project with materials list, step-by-step build instructions, scientific explanation, and difficulty assessment. Supports easy, medium, and hard difficulty levels.

400.description: Invalid request (unsupported grade, difficulty, or budget)

get.description: Retrieve all generated science projects ordered by creation date (newest first).

schema.title: Response List Science Projects Api V1 Science Projects Get

get.description: Retrieve a single generated science project by its unique identifier.

post.description: Generate a CBSE-aligned assessment where the teacher specifies question types, counts, and marks per question. The pattern is auto-saved for reuse. Supports any question types: mcq, short_answer, long_answer, fill_blanks, true_false, match, etc.

get.description: Retrieve all past assessment generations ordered by creation date (newest first).

schema.title: Response List Generation History Api V1 Teacher Assistant History Get

get.description: Retrieve a specific generation with full section details.

schema.title: Response List Prototypes Api V1 Prototypes Get

get.description: Get a single prototype by ID.

put.description: Update the status of a prototype.

post.description: Upload a photo for a prototype.

get.description: List all photos for a prototype.

post.description: Add a text note about a prototype build.

get.description: Get all notes for a prototype.

post.description: Add a material entry for a prototype.

get.description: Get all materials for a prototype.

post.description: Create a cost sheet entry for a prototype.

get.description: Get all cost sheets for a prototype.

post.description: Create a build record for a prototype.

get.description: Get all build records for a prototype.
